summary.headline: Indo Count Q1 FY27 total income rose 13% QoQ to INR1,224 crore and EBITDA margin recovered to 13.1%, with volumes up 12% QoQ.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 delivered the company's highest-ever quarterly revenue, with total income of INR1,224 crore (+13% QoQ, +27% YoY) and EBITDA of INR160 crore (+38% QoQ) at a 13.1% margin. Sales volume rose 12% QoQ to 23 million meters but fell 3% YoY on container shortages linked to the West Asia conflict. The new business (utility bedding and US brands) reached INR387 crore in the quarter. Bhilad plant was hit by flooding from 23 July 2026 and only partially resumed on 12 August 2026; the company says it is fully insured.

financial_highlights.change: Nearly tripled over past one year (per management)
vs INR80 crore last year (per management)
Q4 FY26 included one-off ~INR13 crore GST-related hit

segments.name: Core business (bed linen, quilts, comforters etc.)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR837 crore, +4% QoQ; ~70% US and ~30% non-US. Management says core blended margin is around 15%, with standalone margin slightly above 15% in Q1. Quarterly realisation fell on product mix.

segments.name: New business (utility bedding + US brands)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR387 crore in Q1, all US-linked. Split is roughly two-thirds utility bedding (manufacturing) and one-third brands; brand revenue was slightly above INR125 crore. FY27 target INR1,500 crore; brands target about INR500 crore for the year.

guidance_outlook: FY27 volume guidance reiterated at 105-110 million meters; core business revenue about INR4,000 crore.
FY27 new business revenue target INR1,500 crore; USD275 million new business ambition for 2028 and INR8,000 crore revenue aspiration by CY2028 reiterated.
Non-US revenue expected to grow 20%+ in FY27.
Endeavour to maintain about 13% blended EBITDA margin for FY27 on a consolidated basis; long-term stabilisation target 15-16% for the company as a whole.
Price increases concluded with customers; impact on realisations expected from Q2 onwards. Full-year realisations expected broadly intact.
Interest cost expected at about INR120 crore for FY27 (INR30 crore per quarter), at roughly 6-7%.
Utility bedding utilisation targeted at 60-65% for FY27.
Potential US tariff refund: management expects no material financial benefit; ~80% of exports are FOB; quantification premature, clarity expected by year-end.
capex_capacity: New greenfield facility in North Carolina commenced in January 2026; operations ramping, adding employee costs and a lower-margin gestation period.
Existing US facilities in Ohio and Arizona; utilisation overall around 60-65% in Q1 despite new capacity.

Bhilad (Gujarat) plant hit by flooding from 23 July 2026; partially resumed 12 August 2026 with phased normalisation. Management says other plants are absorbing lost output (endeavour, not confirmed).
Utility bedding business investment about 70-75% complete per management, with balancing investments still to come.
demand_pricing: Volumes recovering as US tariff uncertainty eased; Q1 seen as seasonally softer than Q2 and Q3 (US festive period).
Container availability constraints from the West Asia conflict hit Q1 dispatches; management says the container issue continues.
Raw material costs rose after the February-end war; price increases were negotiated case by case and concluded, with impact from Q2.
Non-US: UK FTA restores level playing field (UK business 8-10% of total); management says client interactions in UK rose from about 4 to 8 a year. EU FTA expected to add further duty-free access.
Competition: India at about 10% US tariff vs neighbours at 10-12.5%; management says no orders or customers were lost even at 50% tariff.

qa_highlights.question: What is the margin difference between core bed linen and the new utility bedding and branded businesses?
qa_highlights.answer: Management targets 15% for both bed linen and utility bedding over time, and brands 100-200 bps above that. Utility bedding is currently lower because the new facility is in gestation; bed linen did slightly better than 15% in Q1.

qa_highlights.question: Is any US tariff refund expected and how is it accounted for?
qa_highlights.answer: No tariff refund was booked in Q1. Management expects no material benefit as ~80% of exports are FOB, and says quantification is premature until year-end.

qa_highlights.question: Will standalone margins decline in Q2 and Q3 given Bhilad disruption and cost pressure?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined precise quarterly guidance; the endeavour is to hold about 13% blended consolidated margin for the full year. Any one-time losses are covered by insurance (property, inventory, loss of profit).

qa_highlights.question: Why is utility bedding utilisation guided at only 60-65% when Q1 already achieved that?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 60-65% is the satisfactory level to plan on for the full year, with stability expected for the rest of FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Interest cost run-rate and weighted average cost of debt?
qa_highlights.answer: Interest cost is about INR30 crore per quarter (INR120 crore annual); the Q4 figure included a one-off ~INR13 crore GST-related charge. Cost is roughly 6-7%, varying by bank; company rated A1+.

qa_highlights.question: Can margins go beyond 15% long term given the shift to branded and e-commerce?
qa_highlights.answer: No ceiling is set. Long-term target is to stabilise at 15-16% for the company as a whole, to be recalibrated as the business progresses.

risks_watch: Bhilad plant recovery pace after flooding; whether lost output is made up in Q2-Q3 without delays in shipments.
Container availability and West Asia-linked freight constraints, which cut Q1 volumes 3% YoY.
Quarterly realisation pressure from product mix; price increases on raw material costs to flow through from Q2.
Utility bedding: non-cotton input cost inflation, and whether it is fully passed on (management says yes, with 2-3 month lag at times).
New business ramp: management says variability is still unknown and about 70-75% of the investment is in place; USD100 million brand target is three years out.
Potential US tariff refund accounting, with clarity expected only by year-end.
summary.management_tone: Confident on recovery and the INR8,000 crore aspiration, but noticeably reluctant to give precise quarterly margin or volume guidance. Management was defensive on Bhilad impact and on the margin question, and fell back on insurance cover and full-year averages.
key_quotes: We delivered our highest ever quarterly revenue, reflecting the growing scale and momentum across our businesses.
Our performance for Q1 is in line with our stated guidance for the year of INR5,500 crores with approximately 13% EBITDA margins.
So for long-term, you can say right now, our target is to stabilize at 15 to 16% margins as a company as a whole.
So our endeavor is to maintain our 13% blended margin on a consolidated basis.
We are adequately insured to cover the losses.
